title: Structural Load Stress Visualization with Save/Load State
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that implements an interactive structural load stress visualization for a simple building frame, with full save/load state functionality.

## Scene Setup
- Use a perspective camera at position (15, 12, 15) looking at the origin.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.4) and a directional light from (10, 20, 10) with intensity 0.8 and shadow mapping enabled.
- Render a ground plane (50x50, gray #444444) at y=0.
- OrbitControls for camera manipulation.
- Background color: #1a1a2e.

## Building Frame Structure
- Create a portal frame structure consisting of:
  - 4 vertical columns (BoxGeometry 0.4 x 6 x 0.4) at corners of a 8x8 footprint, positioned at (±4, 3, ±4).
  - 4 horizontal beams (BoxGeometry 8.8 x 0.3 x 0.3) connecting column tops along each edge at y=6.
  - 2 diagonal cross-braces on two opposite faces (thin cylinders, radius 0.05).
- All structural members start with a neutral color (steel gray #888899).
- Each structural member must be stored in an array `structuralMembers` with properties: id, type ('column'|'beam'|'brace'), mesh reference, baseStress (0), currentStress (0), maxStress (100).

## Load Application System
- The user can place point loads on the structure.
- Clicking on any beam highlights it and selects it as the load target.
- A DOM slider (id='loadSlider', range 0-100, step 5) controls the load magnitude in kN.
- A button (id='applyLoadBtn') applies the current slider value as a downward load on the selected beam.
- When a load is applied:
  - Calculate stress distribution: the loaded beam gets 100% of load stress, columns directly below get 70% of load stress, adjacent beams get 30%, braces get 20%.
  - Stress values are cumulative across multiple load applications.
  - Color each member based on stress ratio (currentStress/maxStress): 0-0.3 green (#00ff44), 0.3-0.6 yellow (#ffcc00), 0.6-0.85 orange (#ff6600), 0.85+ red (#ff0000). Interpolate within each band.
  - If any member exceeds maxStress, mark it as 'failed' and make it flash (toggle visibility every 500ms).
- Track total applied load across all applications.
- A button (id='resetLoadsBtn') resets all stresses to 0 and restores neutral colors.

## Stress Visualization
- Each member should display a small sprite or billboard above it showing its current stress percentage when hovered (use raycasting on mousemove).
- A HUD panel (id='stressPanel', top-right corner) shows:
  - Total applied load (id='totalLoadDisplay')
  - Number of stressed members (id='stressedCount') — members with stress > 0
  - Number of failed members (id='failedCount')
  - Max stress in any member (id='maxStressDisplay')

## Deformation Visualization
- When loads are applied, beams should visually deflect downward proportional to their stress (max deflection 0.3 units at 100% stress). Columns should compress (scale Y reduced by up to 5% at 100% stress).
- A toggle button (id='toggleDeformBtn') enables/disables the deformation visualization. Default: enabled.

## Save/Load State System
- A button (id='saveStateBtn') serializes the entire current state to a JSON string and stores it in `window.__3D_SAVED_STATE__`. The saved state must include: all member stresses, total applied load, selected beam id, deformation toggle state, camera position, and a timestamp.
- A button (id='loadStateBtn') deserializes from `window.__3D_SAVED_STATE__` and restores the full scene state including stresses, colors, deformations, camera position, and HUD values.
- A button (id='clearSaveBtn') sets `window.__3D_SAVED_STATE__` to null.

## State Management (window.__3D_STATE__)
Expose the following on `window.__3D_STATE__`:
- `initialized` (boolean): true when scene is ready
- `memberCount` (number): total structural members
- `members` (array of objects): each with {id, type, currentStress, maxStress, failed, stressRatio}
- `totalAppliedLoad` (number): sum of all applied loads in kN
- `selectedBeamId` (string|null): id of currently selected beam
- `stressedMemberCount` (number): members with stress > 0
- `failedMemberCount` (number): members that exceeded maxStress
- `maxStressValue` (number): highest currentStress across all members
- `deformationEnabled` (boolean): whether deformation viz is on
- `loadApplicationCount` (number): how many times loads have been applied
- `hasSavedState` (boolean): whether window.__3D_SAVED_STATE__ is non-null
- `cameraPosition` (object): {x, y, z} of camera
- `lastAction` (string): last user action performed ('none'|'select'|'applyLoad'|'reset'|'save'|'load'|'clearSave'|'toggleDeform')

Update `window.__3D_STATE__` synchronously after every user action.
physics_constraints: Stress distribution follows simplified static analysis: loaded beam receives 100% load, supporting columns 70%, adjacent beams 30%, braces 20%. Stresses are cumulative and capped at member maxStress. Deformation is linearly proportional to stress ratio. Total applied load must equal the sum of all individual load applications. No member stress may be NaN or negative. Failed members are those with currentStress >= maxStress.
